caption: A shopping cart rolls across a parking lot, runs into a concrete curb, and stops abruptly.

sa.check: A shopping cart rolls across a parking lot.
It runs into a concrete curb.
It stops abruptly at the curb.
The concrete curb in the cart's path is visible.
The rolling comes first and the stop at the curb follows.

pc.expect: The cart's stop happens where its wheels meet the curb, not anywhere else.
pc.fail: The cart stops on open tarmac before reaching the curb; or it reaches the curb and rolls on unaffected; or it stops with no curb or obstacle in its path.

pc.expect: The wheels are checked at the curb while the basket carries on, so the cart jolts and may tip forward before settling back.
pc.fail: The cart comes to rest at the curb with no jolt or tip at all; or it bounces back from the curb quicker than it arrived; or it keeps rolling forward at its old speed after the contact.

pc.expect: The cart stays on its side of the curb and above the tarmac.
pc.fail: The cart's wheels pass through the concrete curb; or the cart sinks into the tarmac at the stop; or the basket passes through the curb while the wheels stay behind it.

pc.expect: Items in the basket pitch forward at the moment the cart is stopped.
pc.fail: Items in the basket stay still while the cart jolts to a halt; or they pitch backward; or they move before the cart reaches the curb.
pc.precondition: Items are visible in the cart's basket.

pc.expect: One cart and one curb keep their number and shape.
pc.fail: The cart vanishes at the curb or a second one appears; or a wheel comes away and hangs in the air; or the curb disappears where the cart meets it.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The cart's colour, the lot markings and the background stay the same.
pc.fail: The cart changes colour at the impact; or the painted bay lines shift between frames; or the buildings behind rearrange.
